name: Necrolisk

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Entrapping Saliva
traits.summary: Its grapples and restraints work on incorporeal creatures; swallowed creatures can't phase out or teleport away.
traits.text: The necrolisk ignores the Grappled and Restrained immunities of a creature with Incorporeal Movement. A creature it has swallowed can't pass out through it with Incorporeal Movement or by the Ethereal Plane, and can't teleport out of its stomach.

traits.name: Herb Allergy
traits.summary: If it eats a 25 gp herb mixture (for example one a swallowed creature pours in), at the end of the turn it vomits up whatever it swallowed.
traits.text: If the necrolisk eats a particular herb mixture worth 25 gp (for instance a swallowed creature pouring it into the stomach with a Utilize action), then at the end of that turn it spits out everything in its stomach as though it had failed the save in its Swallow.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.summary: Climbs difficult surfaces, even upside down on ceilings, with no ability check.
traits.text: The necrolisk can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without an ability check.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.summary: Burrows through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed, leaving a 10-ft tunnel.
traits.text: The necrolisk can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a tunnel 10 feet across behind it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: One Bite and one Claws attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.summary: +10, reach 15 ft, 2d8+6 Piercing plus 1d6 Force; a Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 16) and Restrained.
actions.text: A long-necked bite: 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Force damage. A Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 16) and Restrained until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text: Raking claws: 9 (1d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Force damage.

actions.name: Ephemeral Spit
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. 60-ft line, DC 16 Dex save: 12d6 Force (half on a success) and Restrained until the end of its next turn on a failure.
actions.text: A spray of ghostly saliva down a line 60 feet long and 5 feet wide. Dexterity save, DC 16, each creature in it. Failure: 42 (12d6) Force damage, and the target is Restrained until the end of its next turn. Success: half damage only.

bonus_actions.name: Swallow
bonus_actions.summary: One Large or smaller creature it has Grappled: DC 18 Dex save or swallowed (Blinded, Restrained, total cover, 6d6 Force each turn); holds one at a time.
bonus_actions.text: Dexterity save, DC 18, one Large or smaller creature the necrolisk is grappling (one swallowed creature at a time). Failure: it is swallowed and no longer Grappled. Inside, it is Blinded and Restrained, has Total Cover against anything outside, and takes 21 (6d6) Force damage at the start of each of the necrolisk's turns. If the necrolisk takes 30 or more damage in one turn from the swallowed creature, it must make a DC 14 Constitution save at the end of that turn or spit the creature out Prone in a space within 10 feet. If the necrolisk dies, the swallowed creature is freed and climbs out using 15 feet of movement, ending Prone.

summary: A grave-digging drake that tunnels to crypts, grabs prey with a long-reaching bite, swallows it, and spits a ghostly beam down a line.
